body.heading: Find a nameless thing
paragraphs: Some things have no word. The happy feeling when you smell dinner cooking. The wobble of a loose tooth.
Pick one nameless thing. Say it slowly and think about what it feels like.

body.heading: Build your word
paragraphs: Squash two words together, or make a sound that fits. The dinner-smell feeling could be yumwait.
Teach your word to your family and use it all week. You are now a word inventor.

takeaway: If something has no word, you can be the person who invents one.
safetyNotes: Made-up words are for fun at home; be kind and do not tease anyone with them.
screenFreeExtension: Write your new word in your picture dictionary so nobody forgets it.
